newsitem.title: USA: Magazine group worried over warning to advertisers.
newsitem.headline: Magazine group worried over warning to advertisers.

text.p: The American Society of Magazine Editors Monday expressed concern over what it described as a "trend among some magazines to give advertisers advance notice of upcoming articles."

ASME President Frank Lalli, managing editor of Money magazine, said the group has learned that several publishers "routinely alert advertisers about upcoming articles so that advertisers can decide whether to reschedule, or even pull, their ads. The ASME board of directors is deeply concerned about this early-warning trend."
Lalli said such early warnings "may be mistaken by advertisers as an invitation to pressure publications to alter articles in accord with advertisers's wishes."
